talk.jaymospowers.patrol.greet.1: "Galactic Patrol. Don't mind me, just making my rounds. Your town's quiet. Mostly."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.greet.2: "Hey there. I put down here to stretch my legs and thump whatever's been bothering your folk at night."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.greet.3: "Easy, I'm one of the good ones. Patrol. I'll be gone again in a day or so."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.greet.strong.1: "Whoa. You've got some fight in you, don't you? I can feel it from here."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.greet.strong.2: "Now that's a power level. What's someone like you doing kicking dirt in a place like this?"
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.greet.strong.3: "You're strong. Stronger than most I meet out there, and I meet a lot."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.greet.officer.1: "Officer! Good to see a badge this far out. Keeping the worlds honest?"
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.greet.officer.2: "There's my fellow patroller. Need anything before I head off?"
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.greet.officer.3: "Hey, partner. Any warrants giving you trouble?"
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.opt.travels: Where have your travels taken you?
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.story.0: "Rustfall, last week. Every step there is like carrying a man on your back. I sparred a whole night and came home twice the fighter. My knees have not forgiven me."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.story.1: "Ever been to Glacia? Ice to the end of the world. I chased a thief across it for an hour and we both fell through. He came up first. I came up angrier."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.story.2: "Cinder's the one nearest the sun. Pack food, more than you think. The heat eats at you, and the forges eat at the people."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.story.3: "The Maw. Don't go near the middle. I've seen what's left of ships that did. The wrecks out on the rim, though, they're full of things nobody's come back for."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.story.4: "The pale moon's close and quiet. Too quiet. Tall dark things stand about up there and just watch. Don't look them in the eye."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.story.5: "These pods? Nobody makes them anymore. Some old genius had the trick of it, and then one day he and his big clock-machine just weren't there. The ones flying now are the ones that are left."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.story.6: "The Warrior-born raiders are the worst of it. They come down in pods of their own, take what they like and leave. Where they get their pods, I wish I knew."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.story.7: "There's a green world out past all of it. Moss and vines and quiet. I go there when I need to remember what we're fighting for."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.told.1: "That's all my best stories. Ask me again after my next run."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.told.2: "You've heard everything worth hearing. Go make some stories of your own."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.not_yet.1: "Ha! I like the spirit. But out there they'd eat you alive. Get stronger, then ask me again."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.not_yet.2: "Not yet, friend. The patrol needs fighters who can hold their own against warlords. Train. Then we'll talk."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.not_yet.3: "Your power's a spark right now. Come back when it's a fire."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.offer.1: "You know what, you'd do. We're always short of good fighters. Swear to keep the worlds safe and you'll get a pod, full tanks, and a license to bring in the worst of them."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.offer.2: "The patrol could use you. A pod of your own, a license, and a bounty on every crook you bring down. What do you say?"
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.sworn: "Then it's done. Welcome to the Galactic Patrol, Rookie. A pod stands fuelled beside you and your license is good on every world. Land somewhere far, and there'll be someone wanted there."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.fuel.1: "Here, take some of mine. Keep those tanks full."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.fuel.2: "Fuel? Always. Can't have an officer stranded."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.report: "%1$s, %2$s arrests. Keep it up and they'll give you my job."
message.jaymospowers.patrol.warrant: Patrol warrant: %1$s is hiding on %2$s. Bounty: %3$s emeralds.
message.jaymospowers.patrol.escaped: %1$s got away while you were gone.
message.jaymospowers.patrol.arrest: %1$s is brought down. Bounty: %2$s emeralds. Arrests: %3$s.
message.jaymospowers.patrol.promoted: Promoted: you are now a Galactic Patrol %1$s.
message.jaymospowers.patrol.not_yours: This license isn't made out to you.
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.pod.1: "Pods? Mine! My design, every rivet. Or it was, before... hm. Before. The drawings went with the big machine, and the big machine went with... where did it go? Don't ask me to make another. I can't remember how."
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.pod.2: "Ah, the little ships. Lovely things. I had it all up here once, the burner, the guidance, all of it. Then the clock-machine took it all with it. Now I couldn't build one if you held a wrench to my throat."
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.pod.3: "Don't buy one from me, I haven't got any. Nobody has, not new. Whatever's flying out there is what's left, and the raiders have most of it."
message.jaymospowers.raiders.beaten: The raiders are beaten. One of their pods still ticks over where it landed.
